page.marginRule: Equal on all four edges. Slightly tighter than the résumé so image grids keep width; never shrink a single edge.

contentBox.rule: At 0.6in margins the printable area is 11 − 1.2 = 9.8in tall. Print `.page` uses fixed height + overflow:hidden (same family as two-page-standard).

pageModel.footer: .footer.page-sig { margin-top: auto; align-self: flex-end; text-align: right; }
pageModel.printPage: .page { height: 9.8in; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
pageModel.rule: Visual portfolio: header flows; signature pins bottom-RIGHT (same as résumé). Portfolio / live-work URLs belong in a body .links-panel — NEVER a L/R footer row (false-triggers footer-collision) and NEVER an extra line above the footer.

signature.not: Cover-letter bottom-LEFT · L/R footer row with links opposite the script (phantom collision)

pagination.trap: A trailing break-after: page emits a phantom blank sheet. A stacked .foot-line above the footer duplicates the portfolio section — put links in the body instead.

heroCaption: Caption sits BELOW the hero image (not overlaid). Structure: .hero > .frame > img, then .hero .cap.
verticalRhythm: Use .page-main flex column with a generous gap (~20px) between sections and ~14px between subsections, plus padding-bottom clear of the signature band — NOT justify-content:space-between (that plus a tall grid can false-trigger footer-collision). Category h2 ~13px with ~14px bottom margin. Check visible gaps in both PDF themes and move content before shrinking equal page margins.
imageFit: For decorative game-art thumbnails, fill the frame with object-fit: cover and choose object-position to retain the subject; inspect the exported crop and remove baked-in letterboxing from the source crop when needed. Use contain when the whole screenshot, interface, text, or evidence must remain visible. Do not stretch the image or crop essential content.
cardSurface: Use a subtle translucent, bordered glass-like surface where appropriate, with a legible opaque or composited print fallback. Verify light and dark exported PDFs; backdrop-filter alone is not a reliable printed effect.
fullRowGroups: Stats rows, link-chip rows, and any peer-item strip MUST span the full content width — use grid repeat(N, minmax(0,1fr)), never a left-clustered flex that leaves half the row empty. Same rule as résumé Online Community badges.
linksPanel: Portfolio & live work matches Studio at a glance: section h2 OUTSIDE any card; .link-row = grid repeat(4, 1fr) peer chips (same visual language as .stats). Never wrap the title inside a bordered panel. All URLs real <a href>. Live: lines after Agency are NOT list bullets.
footerMail: Signature email uses --text (or --accent), ≥11px, font-weight 600 — never --dim2 at 9px. Same rule across résumé + cover letter + work samples.

brandAssets.mgLogo: Optional. Default work-examples omits the MG mark in shipped-games. If used elsewhere, prefer SQUARE 1×1 — not landscape 16×9 in the header.

tenureRule: Studio at a glance: studio age (25 yrs founded 2000) and applicant tenure (Jenni = 15 yrs from Dec 2011) are DIFFERENT. Never tag the glance as 'Martian Games · 25 years' if it reads as the applicant's tenure — prefer 'studio · founded 2000' + a separate '15 yrs with studio' badge.
bestFor: Every work-samples / Additional Documents visual portfolio. Résumés use two-page-standard.json; cover letters use one-page-letter.json.
